question: 시스템이 작동하지 않으면 어떻게 해야 하나요?
english_query: What should I do if the system does not work?

sources.text:

Column 1: Problem | Column 2: What to do
Column 1: System does not function | Column 2: . Make sure the power cord is fully plugged into an operating electrical outlet. Press On/Off to see if the display lights.

Customer service
If you lose your remote, additional remotes are available from Bose® Customer Service. For additional help in solving problems, contact Bose Customer Service. See the phone numbers listed inside the back cover of this guide.

The setup menu allows you to personalize system operation
• Reset to factory settings

The setup menu allows you to personalize system operation
Factory system settings have been set to satisfy most owners. If you wish to change the settings, see “Personalizing Your Wave® Music System” on page 20.

Column 1: No sound | Column 2: Turn the volume up. Press Mute. Eject theCD and reload it. Check connections for an auxiliary source. Press AUX to listen to an external source connected to the AUXINinput Make sure the external source is turned on. Disconnect headphones.

Column 1: Remote control is incon- sistent or does not work | Column 2: Operate the remote control closer to the unit. Check that the remote control battery is installed with positive (+)polarity facing up. Replace the remote control battery. Check for interference from room lighting,sunlight,or dust or dirt on lens. Try the unit in a different location.

answer: 시스템이 작동하지 않는 경우, 전원 코드를 작동하는 전기 콘센트에 완전히 꽂아주세요. 그리고 On/Off 버튼을 눌러 디스플레이가 켜지는지 확인하세요.
